card.name: Advanced or metastatic before cancer type
card.fires_on: The word "advanced" or the middle of "metastatic" placed just before a cancer type such as ovarian, prostate or pancreatic. It also fires on a few other words that introduce a disease descriptor.

modes.label: Stage word before cancer
